profile_edit_evidenceHint: Anything you add here is marked self-declared. A skill confirmed by your university's registry arrives with a transferred transcript instead — it is not something to type.
profile_edit_expiresOnHint: Leave empty if it does not expire.
profile_edit_privacyHint: Off hides your join date and badges from strangers. Your name stays visible wherever you have posted — hiding that would break the comment, not the profile.
profile_transcriptMixedScales: Mixed grading scales — no single average
search_placeholder: An exercise, a topic, a formula — try “całka” or “Cauchy”
search_prompt: Type something to search the exercises and materials.
submitMaterial_whereHint: Upload the file, or give a link to where it already lives — one or the other, not both.
submitMaterial_urlHint: For something you should not re-host — a recording, a department page, somebody else’s published notes.
taxonomy_propose_parentDiscipline: Which discipline does it belong to?
course_links_hint: Paste the address of an exercise, a material or a discussion — it becomes a real link, not just text in the description.
course_links_valueHint: The address from the page you want. A discussion needs the link from that comment’s own ⋯ menu.
course_links_unrecognised: That does not look like a link to anything here. Paste the address from the page you want, or type its id.
comment_copyLinkFailed: The link could not be copied.
comment_linkToCourse_title: Link this discussion to a course
comment_linkToCourse_hint: It is added as a link, so the thread stays where it is and keeps its replies.
comment_linkToCourse_failed: That could not be linked — it may already be in the course, or be a reply rather than the start of a thread.
comment_linkToCourse_noCourses: You do not run any courses yet.
settings_savedCommentsHint: What you kept from discussions around the site. Only you can see this.
savedComments_none: You have not saved anything yet.
seo_home_description: A living database of university mathematics, physics and computer-science exercises — every one with a worked solution, community ratings and discussion. Browse by discipline, branch and topic.
seo_disciplines_description: Browse EdMat by discipline and branch — mathematics, physics and computer science, each with its university courses and exercise collections.
seo_courses_description: Courses run on EdMat by their own instructors, open to join — with chapters, lessons and contributed material.
seo_materials_description: Course scripts, formula sheets, past exams and lecture notes, filed by course and topic and searchable by content.
seo_events_description: Guest lectures, workshops, study sessions and exam-prep meetups — one-off events you can sign up for.
seo_services_description: Find a tutor by course, online or in person, with published availability you can book directly.
seo_search_description: Search across EdMat's exercises, materials, courses, events and tutoring listings.
seo_levels_description: How standing works on EdMat — the capability and moderation ladders, vote weight, and what is live today versus designed.
seo_privacy_description: What EdMat stores, why, and what it never collects.
seo_login_description: Sign in to EdMat to rate exercises, join the discussion, submit corrections and save your own study sets.
seo_register_description: Create an EdMat account to contribute exercises and translations, review material and build shareable study sets.
coverage_addIntroRequires: Claim how much of a topic — and, optionally, a specific subtopic — a reader should already know before this material is useful to them. The community can then vote on whether the level is accurate, rank how prominently it should be shown, and discuss it.
coverage_requiredLevelHint: How much of this topic you should already know before starting — 1 is nothing at all, 100 is full mastery.
coverage_voteQuestionRequires: Is this level of prior knowledge right?
coverage_badgeTitleRequires: Needs prior knowledge at {level}/100 — open to vote or discuss
coverage_kindExplainCovers: A coverage claim: how thoroughly this material teaches the topic.
coverage_kindExplainRequires: A requirement claim: how much of the topic you should already know before using this material.
coverage_importanceQuestion: Should this be shown near the top?
coverage_importanceNone: Not ranked yet — the first vote sets the order.
coverage_importanceHint: Claims are listed in the order these votes produce, most important first.
material_coversHint: What this material teaches, and how deeply. Click a claim to vote, rank or discuss it.
material_requiresHint: What you should already know before using it. Click a claim to vote, rank or discuss it.
comment_loginToVote: Log in to vote on comments
course_coversHint: What this course teaches, and how deeply. Click a claim to vote, rank or discuss it.
course_requiresHint: What you should already know before joining. Click a claim to vote, rank or discuss it.
coverage_kindExplainCoversCourse: A coverage claim: how thoroughly this course teaches the topic.
coverage_kindExplainRequiresCourse: A requirement claim: how much of the topic you should already know before joining this course.
exercise_coversHint: What this exercise practises, and how deeply. Click a claim to vote, rank or discuss it.
exercise_requiresHint: What you should already know to attempt it. Click a claim to vote, rank or discuss it.
coverage_kindExplainCoversExercise: A coverage claim: how thoroughly this exercise practises the topic.
coverage_kindExplainRequiresExercise: A requirement claim: how much of the topic you should already know to attempt this exercise.
taxonomy_otherDisciplineFor: Which discipline does it belong to?
taxonomy_otherPending: A new entry you name here is created when you submit — real straight away, and listed under "Others" until a moderator confirms it.
